selections.scope_rationale: The selected primary result is the requested composite: the report identifies cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure as the primary outcome, analyzed as time to first event, and reports the combined effect as HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.65 to 0.86). The supplement's adjudicated hospitalization criteria specify new/worsening HF symptoms and objective evidence, matching the target's worsening-HF hospitalization concept. The target's time frame is trial follow-up, not a fixed horizon; all patients were followed for prespecified outcomes for the full trial duration and the median follow-up was 16 months. The report's 361/1863 versus 462/1867 event counts and its ITT Cox model are the same randomized comparison and estimand requested.
selections.population_rationale: The target is all randomized eligible patients in this HFrEF trial. The primary analysis explicitly used the intention-to-treat principle and data through the planned treatment period for all randomized patients; eligibility criteria defined adults with chronic NYHA II–IV HF and LVEF ≤40%, receiving appropriate HF therapy. The target is therefore the trial's randomized population, not a broader external HFrEF population.
unknowns: The report notes 21 patients had unknown vital status at trial end and 42 patients were lost to follow-up at various times; the extent and handling of missing primary outcome ascertainment are not fully detailed in the main report.
The primary report gives median follow-up (16 months), not an identical fixed follow-up duration for each participant.

counterevidence.implication: The main report states that 21 participants had unknown vital status at trial end and 42 were lost to follow-up; this qualifies complete outcome ascertainment but does not change the ITT target or reported time-to-first-event comparison.
